baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance supplies gentle direction, while the superlative destination combines straightness with the framework by which a thing remains standing. The verse therefore presents orientation toward a configuration that is both right and sustaining.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies the directional action of the focus verb.
Straightness, balance, and evenness define the destination as an ordered configuration.
That by which a thing stands and endures makes the superlative sustaining, not merely correct.

changed_reading.before: The Quran states which option is morally right.
changed_reading.after: The Quran gently leads toward the most straight and life-sustaining configuration.

baseline_models.mechanism: The named recitation gathers material, voices it, and patterns a way; guidance then gives that gathered recitation direction and manner. Its unity is functional: dispersed material becomes a course that can be followed.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining supply the integrative operation of the named recitation.
Reading and recitation make that gathered material an enacted utterance rather than a static object.
A way, pattern, and intended course lets recitation organize conduct by repeated form.
Direction, course, and manner turn the gathered recitation into lived orientation.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is a bounded text that contains guidance.
changed_reading.after: The Quran guides by gathering and voicing material as a repeatable, followable way.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: An announcement opens the recipient toward joy, trusted assent settles the heart, intentional work restores what has left sound order, and recompense returns from that work at enlarged scale. The relative clause is an operative sequence rather than a list of eligibility labels.

activation_trace.role: News that opens the skin with joy gives the promise an embodied anticipatory effect.
Heart-settling assent makes belief the trusted reception of the announced future.
Intentional action converts settled trust into purposive conduct.
Soundness opposed to corruption defines the work by its reparative effect.
Recompense returning from work closes the action-outcome circuit.
Magnitude enlarges the returned outcome beyond an ordinary wage.

changed_reading.before: Believers who satisfy a good-deed condition receive a large payment.
changed_reading.after: Trusted announcement settles into intentional repair, whose consequence returns at a scale larger than ordinary exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement through night toward disclosed signs turns the focus verb from abstract instruction into navigable passage under partial visibility. The earlier written guidance then makes the focus claim a renewed instance of guidance embodied in a transmitted text.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a road anchors the changed reading in the focus verb.
Travel by night supplies an enacted route whose destination is reached before full visibility.
Causing something to be seen makes disclosure occur along the route rather than only before it.
A manifest sign supplies the route with orienting markers.
Ordered letters and the written object make guidance transmissible across communities and time.
The prior occurrence explicitly joins a text to gentle directional guidance and strengthens the focus claim.

structural_cues: 17:1 is a night passage between bounded places undertaken so that signs become visible.
17:2 immediately turns an earlier written gift into guidance before 17:9 applies the same function to this Quran.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial travel, progressive disclosure, signs, and prior text-as-guidance; I infer that the focus guidance is enacted navigation through incomplete visibility. A live alternative is that the journey only frames revelation and does not define its guiding mode.

changed_reading.before: Guidance communicates a correct destination from outside the journey.
changed_reading.after: Guidance carries the reader through obscurity, disclosing orienting signs along a text-mediated route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pairing of uprightness and sound work is set inside a sequence where order leaves soundness, conduct rebounds upon the acting self, return meets return, and mercy remains possible. The most upright way thus acts as a recursive repair order capable of correcting recurrent breakdown.

activation_trace.role: A sustaining framework anchors the focus destination as an order that must keep standing.
Soundness against corruption makes the focus works locally reparative.
Departure from soundness and balance supplies the systemic failure that repair must answer.
Doing what is good supplies the positive input whose effect returns to its agents.
The self as the very entity acted upon localizes the feedback of conduct.
Tender mercy keeps correction from being a closed punitive cycle.
Return after departure and renewed action supply the repeated feedback structure.

structural_cues: 17:4-8 repeats corruption, consequence, restored capacity, renewed conduct, and renewed response.
17:7 grammatically directs both good and bad conduct back upon the acting selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposition between soundness and corruption, reflexive consequence, repeated return, and an opening for mercy; I infer a feedback arrow in which conduct destabilizes or restores the order that bears its agents. A live alternative is a purely historical cycle without a general repair mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The most upright way is a one-time choice of the straight path.
changed_reading.after: The most upright way is a self-correcting order in which conduct returns upon agents and recurrent failure can be met by repair and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The announcement branch can carry an adverse outcome when qualified, and the immediately coordinated continuation supplies a prepared painful outcome for nonbelief. The Quran's announcing function therefore opens two opposed futures rather than offering undifferentiated reassurance.

activation_trace.role: Joy-opening news, with an attested adverse use when qualified, anchors the announcement's affective reversal.
The negated heart-settling assent reverses the recipient condition from the focus clause.
A present, prepared outcome makes the adverse future as concretely awaiting as the promised reward.
Painful punishment supplies the opposed content that darkens the announcement register.

structural_cues: 17:10 begins with a coordination that directly follows the promised great reward while reversing both recipient and outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate coordination, nonbelief, and prepared punishment; I infer that the Quran's outcome-disclosing function continues across the ayah boundary. A materially live alternative is that the coordination occurs at a higher syntactic level and leaves the focus verb exclusively positive.

changed_reading.before: The focus announcement is a positive promise isolated from the following warning.
changed_reading.after: The Quran discloses a bifurcated future: joy-opening reward for trusted repair and a prepared painful outcome for refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human haste collapses evil and good into the same urgent request, while alternating signs enable counting and detailed separation. Activated by the Quran root's timing branch, guidance to the most upright becomes a discipline of retiming, partitioning, and reckoning before judging what is good.

activation_trace.role: A time that comes due or is delayed gives the named recitation an exploratory temporal register.
Equal weight and measured balance let uprightness operate as calibration.
Speed and premature advancement supply the cognitive pressure that confuses harmful and beneficial requests.
Manifest signs turn temporal alternation into readable evidence.
Counting and calculation supply the operation that tests impressions across time.
Detailed separation of parts and meanings prevents haste from collapsing unlike outcomes.

structural_cues: 17:11 says the human calls for evil in the same manner as for good and attributes this collapse to haste.
17:12 answers with alternating phases, countable years, calculation, and exhaustive differentiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies haste, misclassification, temporal alternation, calculation, and detailed separation; I infer that delaying and segmenting judgment is one way the focus guidance produces uprightness. The timing branch of the Quran root is exploratory, and a live alternative is that the signs concern providential utility without defining a reading discipline.

changed_reading.before: Guidance immediately identifies the morally superior option.
changed_reading.after: Guidance trains temporal discrimination: wait, separate phases, and reckon consequences so urgent desire is not mistaken for good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The present recitation guides action; action adheres to the person, becomes a spread written record, and is later read by that same person as sufficient self-accounting. Reading this Quran can therefore function as rehearsal for becoming able to read what one's own work has written.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation anchor the model in the named focus object.
Intentional action supplies the material that the later record makes legible.
Binding and attaching by judgment makes the person's consequence inseparable from the agent.
Ordered writing converts lived action into an inspectable record.
A spread written record supplies the exposed object of later reading.
The command to read transfers the focus operation from revealed recitation to the person's own record.
Accounting makes self-reading evaluative rather than merely archival.
Repeated self-directed guidance links present orientation to personal consequence.

structural_cues: 17:13-14 moves from conduct attached to each person to an opened book and an imperative to read it.
17:15 makes guidance and straying return to the self and blocks transfer of another person's burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present recitation, intentional work, attached record, future reading, accounting, and self-directed consequence; I infer a pedagogical arrow from reading revelation now to reading oneself later. A live alternative is that the later scene describes judgment only and does not imply present rehearsal.

changed_reading.before: The Quran gives rules now, while the personal record belongs to a separate later judgment.
changed_reading.after: Reading the Quran now rehearses accountable self-reading: one's intentional work is already becoming the record one must eventually read.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast separates desire for the immediate from desire for the afterward, then requires motion proportioned to that horizon together with belief. Since both groups receive present extension, the focus work is sharpened into horizon-matched striving, and its great recompense opens onto graded rather than merely immediate scale.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action anchors later striving in the focus relative clause.
Return from work anchors the changed scale in the promised recompense.
Will and desire supply one possible governing horizon for action.
Acceleration and precedence characterize the immediate horizon and its compressed payoff.
A contrasting act of willing points action toward the farther horizon.
Purposeful motion toward a sought end makes work proportionate to its chosen horizon.
Heart-settling assent supplies the trust under which farther-horizon striving remains coherent.
Recognition of benefit makes the striving acknowledged rather than lost.
Magnitude reappears comparatively and locates the focus reward on the larger scale.
Movement degree by degree turns greatness into articulated levels rather than undifferentiated bulk.

structural_cues: 17:18-20 contrasts two desired horizons while stating that present provision is extended to both groups.
17:19 repeats striving three times around belief, and 17:21 relocates the greater comparison to graded afterward outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing horizons, purposeful striving, belief, shared present provision, and greater later degrees; I infer that the focus phrase about working sound deeds compresses desire plus effort fitted to the desired horizon. A live alternative is that sound deeds remain broader than this specifically eschatological orientation.

changed_reading.before: Any good deed earns a large compensation added to present goods.
changed_reading.after: Believing work is sustained motion fitted to a farther horizon, and its great recompense occupies a graded scale beyond immediate allotment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The broken-bone branch is a technical and form-distant image, so it should not replace the ordinary recompense sense. It remains directly anchored in the focus noun and gains local force from sound work, corruption, restoration, and destruction; downstream prose should present it only as a reparative resonance in which reward also answers fracture, possibly without erasing every residual deformation.

activation_trace.role: A broken member mending, even on residual crookedness, gives recompense an exploratory reparative image.
Restored soundness supplies the focus-side operation that makes mending coherent.
Departure from soundness supplies the fracture-like condition preceding repair.
Return to a prior place supplies restoration after breakdown.
Root-level destruction gives the reparative resonance a real damaged order to answer.

changed_reading.before: The great recompense is exclusively a wage paid after good work.
changed_reading.after: Without losing the wage sense, the great recompense may also resonate as large-scale mending of an order fractured by corruption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The standing-versus-sitting antithesis is reader-constructed rather than explicitly marked, and the weakened-legs branch is especially oblique. It remains anchored in the focus superlative and the window's final sitting and abandonment images; downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic echo, not a lexical paraphrase of uprightness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَقْوَمُ as the destination of guidance

activation_trace.role: Bodily rising and standing give the focus superlative a kinetic vertical image.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking turns uprightness into mobilized agency.
Sitting back from action supplies the kinetic opposite of resolute rising.
Mutual weakening of the legs sharpens abandonment into inability to sustain upright action.

changed_reading.before: The most upright is a static description of moral correctness.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified kinetic echo, the most upright is what raises a person into sustained action, against divided allegiance that ends in disabled sitting.

strongest_changes: Guidance became embodied navigation through obscurity and disclosed signs rather than detached instruction.
Uprightness and sound work became a recursive repair order in which conduct returns upon its agents.
Reading the Quran became rehearsal for reading the personal record that one's work is already writing.
Work and great recompense became horizon-matched striving and graded outcome beyond immediate provision.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly converted lexical images into operations: travel, sign exposure, recurrent return, temporal calculation, self-accounting, and graded striving. The most distinctive activations were future self-reading and the contained resonance of recompense as mending.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic scope of the coordination in 17:10 leaves the bifurcated-announcement model less than certain.
The timing branch of the Quran root and the broken-bone branch of recompense are live but branch-distant.
The standing-versus-sitting contrast may be a contextual kinetic echo rather than an intended lexical linkage.
